sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module allows the student to develop a programme idea within a number of Television genres including live TV Studio. Students will research, develop and deliver a programme idea that can be developed further through the subsequent levels of their programme of study. The idea will be developed and pitched to a panel for consideration
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Develop and research programme content that is appropriate to a given commissioning outline. B. Present a programme idea in a pitch presentation C. Critically reflect on the development of their content and how the nature of that content will appeal to audiences
sections.Method of teaching and learning: Students will learn to develop, research and plan programme content in the seminar sessions. They will look at case studies and development formats within lectures. Lectures Seminars Self-directed learning
